app.title: Playlist Downloader for Aparat
loader.label: Playlist link
quality.hint: Applies to every video. Uses the best available quality at or below your choice, or the lowest available. You can then adjust individual videos.
size.label: Size
size.reported: Size reported by Aparat for the selected quality
popup.background: Downloads continue when this popup closes.
error.background: Could not connect to the background downloader
msg.pasteLink: Paste a playlist link such as {example}
msg.empty: This playlist has no available videos.
msg.runFailed: Download queue failed ({error}). You can retry the remaining videos.
msg.stopFailed: Could not stop a download ({error}). Cancel it in your browser's Downloads page or wait for it to finish.
msg.loadFailed: Could not load the playlist ({error}). Check the link and try again.
msg.partial: Aparat returned {got} of {total} videos. Only those can be downloaded.
status.noLink: No download link available (login may be required)
msg.browserCancelled: A browser download was cancelled. Pending videos were stopped. If an external manager took over, check its downloads before retrying; disable its automatic browser capture to keep filenames and folders. See Downloads and external managers above.
download.help: Downloads use your browser in Firefox, Chrome and Edge. If IDM or another manager takes over, this extension cannot track its progress or preserve its folders and filenames. Disable automatic capture for this browser in that manager, then retry. Browser cancellation does not confirm an external download succeeded.
